description:
£145 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this fully furnished six-bedroom student house, ideally located in a popular student area close to Newcastle City Centre.

The property offers six spacious double bedrooms, three bathrooms and multiple reception rooms, providing plenty of space for both socialising and relaxing. Double glazing throughout adds to the comfort of the home, while the convenient location places a variety of takeaways, cafés and local amenities within easy walking distance.

Perfectly suited to student living, this property offers generous accommodation in a fantastic location.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to a member of our Lettings Team.
